digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate, code-grounded advisory criteria (G6/E4 rubric family)
propositions: Plans assert false capability-surface claims about named modules: the module exists but lacks the claimed capability (dc58: completion.py lacks signing; db7b: REVIEW_RESULT not compactable), or the plan claims a capability must be built when the module already provides it (5886: fetcher already emits unmapped-Jira-status alert)
E4's generic existence check for named modules misses finer-grained capability-surface mismatches and cannot detect these three verified miss classes

A new advisory, code-grounded, agent-tier criterion 'asserted-capability' must be added to the G6/E4 rubric family (facet codebase-grounding) to probe capability claims against actual module surfaces using existing pass machinery

The criterion must be registered in registry.CANONICAL_LLM, CODEBASE_GROUNDED, and AGENT_TIER; routed in criteria_routing.json with advisory posture and AGENT exec tier; and documented in rubric and guide without orphan violations

A bounded sanity check (6 live single-criterion runs on 3 E1-verified misses and 3 clean controls) must show recall >=2/3 (gate threshold), with all clean-plan fires marked advisory (non-blocking), feeding into the standing criterion_effectiveness recorder with zero per-criterion wiring
The criterion ships advisory and promotion to blocking posture is a future dogfood-gated change, governed by the advisory→blocking promotion gate protocol in docs/plan-review-gate.md
